events.verdict: Murray (SAC) reaches in as he defends Jokic (DEN) in the post and the contact is marginal.
Murray (SAC) and Jokic (DEN) make incidental contact in pursuit of the rebound.
Jokic (DEN) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Johnson (DEN) briefly clasps and releases Westbrook's (SAC) arm near midcourt.
LaVine's (SAC) shot attempt does not make contact with the rim and the shot clock expires.
Murray (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during Jokic's (DEN) driving shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) has an arm slightly extended in DeRozan's (SAC) path and the contact is marginal.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) is in a legal guarding position when he comes together with Westbrook (SAC) at the end of his drive.
Achiuwa (SAC) comes together with Murray (DEN), who is already off-balance.
Jones (DEN) reaches in and makes contact with DeRozan's (SAC) arm that is more than marginal.
Westbrook (SAC) extends a hand into Jokic's (DEN) body, affecting his jump shot attempt.
Murray (DEN) reaches in and makes clean contact to the ball and DeRozan (SAC) does not lose his balance as a result of any illegal contact.
DeRozan (SAC) reaches in and makes clean contact to the ball and any ensuing contact with Jokic's (DEN) arm while the ball is loose is incidental.
DeRozan (SAC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
